question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

To have a nodding acquaintance
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"To have a nodding acquaintance"** best expresses the meaning of **"Know somebody/something slightly".**
 
• A **"nodding acquaintance" **refers to a casual, superficial knowledge of someone or something.
 
• You might recognize the person and nod to them if you saw them in the street, but you don't know them well. (थोड़ी बहुत जानकारी होना)
 
• **"Know somebody/something slightly" -** This is the correct option. It's a direct definition of "having a nodding acquaintance". 

Therefore, the** correct answer **is:* 'Know somebody/something slightly'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Now, let's examine the other options:
 
 
• **"To have a great experience" -** Having a great experience is more about personally undergoing or living through a particular situation or event which leaves a deep impact. (महान अनुभव होना)
 
• **"To neglect all the parameters" **- This phrase suggests ignoring or not considering all the factors or criteria. (सभी मापदंडों की उपेक्षा करना)
 
• **"To have nothing in common"** - This implies having no similar traits, characteristics, or interests,(कुछ भी सामान्य नहीं होना)
 
 

42:Tbbd,

The correct answer is **'Option 3' **i.e. 'Calming'.</strong
